takeo_r4_anti_overreach.finding: Top1 stability alone does not override the frozen confidence gate. The new diagnostic is not a hidden purchase rule.

interpretation.what_got_stronger: The strongest current lane now has a replayable way to distinguish a score-dominant top1 that is mathematically stable against the full supported fallback perturbation from a merely fragile fallback agreement.
interpretation.what_did_not_change: No model coefficient, confidence threshold, ticket rule, odds band, value threshold, stake, protected dataset state, or economic conclusion changed.
interpretation.current_bottleneck: Clean prospective evidence: complete PRE racecards followed by immutable prediction freezes, genuine timestamped PRE prices where required, and only later post-event scoring. More same-signal model complexity cannot substitute for this evidence.

next_without_owner: Continue scanning for complete reproducible future racecards without inferring race composition from entrant lists or prior-day results.
For each valid future racecard, freeze S0/challenger prediction result-blind and odds-blind under the existing prespec.
Use fallback robustness only as a diagnostic label; never let it override the frozen 0.40 confidence gate or price gate.
Confidence fail => NO_BET with no odds lookup. Confidence pass => freeze one top3 3renhuku ticket before any price lookup.
Acquire only genuine timestamped current PRE odds after the prediction freeze; unverified price remains NO_BET_UNVERIFIED.
Do not score economics until the target result becomes public after all corresponding PRE records are immutable.
Measure later ROI, drawdown, losing streak and winner-concentration controls and require later unseen reproduction before any profitability claim.
Keep formal 30/60 support lane independent and protected holdouts unopened.
